title: A second claim that names an already-sighted worktree never gets its own named-root sighting, so its acceptance evaluation refuses
outcome: Each claim that names a source root gets a measured named-root sighting for its own root generation, even when another claim held by the same session already named and sighted the same worktree path, so termal_evaluate_acceptance works for every such claim without needing a separate worktree per item.
acceptance: The cause is established from source: why a claim naming a worktree already sighted for another claim of the same session receives no sighting for its own root generation.
A behavioural test names one worktree for two claims, focuses each in turn, and shows that each claim receives a sighting at its own generation and that acceptance evaluation is admitted for both.
The review pair is clean and the full gate passes on the exact landed input.
